title: What Delay-Tolerant Social Nets Is
definition: Delay-Tolerant Social Nets: social networks for interplanetary delays.
description:
Delay-Tolerant Social Nets: social networks for interplanetary delays. This is Future Communications & Interfaces at its most ambitious — async protocols research, net logistics engineering and conversation threading operations converging on a single goal: making net hulls real.

Why it matters: Future Communications & Interfaces will decide offline-first outcomes this century. Delay-Tolerant Social Nets is one of the load-bearing ideas: without working net hulls, the larger async protocols vision stalls, and with it, the net logistics systems that depend on it.

title: Delay-Tolerant Social Nets Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Delay-Tolerant Social Nets: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Delay-Tolerant Social Nets — social networks for interplanetary delays.

Phase 1 — Prove (async protocols): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (net logistics): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (conversation threading): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (offline-first): net hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and space-scale deployment begins.

Public edition: phases follow documented research readiness. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.
